etapes.fr: Un bon récit mélange : passé continu (décor), passé simple (actions), past perfect (ce qui s'était passé avant).
etapes.en: Mix past continuous (background), past simple (main events) and past perfect (earlier events).

etapes.fr: Lecture : « It was raining heavily and I was walking home alone. All of a sudden, I heard footsteps behind me. I had heard stories about thieves in that street, so I started to run. To my surprise, the footsteps ran too! In the end, I turned around… It turned out that it was my little brother, who had followed me to borrow some money! »
etapes.en: Notice the three past tenses working together.

etapes.question: In the story, why did the narrator run?
choix: Because he had heard stories about thieves.
etapes.explication: He had heard stories about thieves.

etapes.question: Who was behind him?
etapes.explication: It turned out that it was his little brother.

etapes.en: All of a sudden the lights went out
etapes.fr: Tout à coup la lumière s'est éteinte
Pendant qu'il dormait, quelqu'un était entré dans la maison.
reponses: While he was sleeping, someone had entered the house.
While he was asleep, someone had come into the house.
While he was sleeping, somebody had entered the house.

etapes.en: To my surprise, everybody was waiting for me.
choix: À ma grande surprise, tout le monde m'attendait.
Je n'étais pas surpris, personne n'était là.
Tout le monde a été surpris de me voir.

etapes.en: It was a dark night and I was walking home alone…
etapes.fr: C'était une nuit sombre et je rentrais seul(e) chez moi…

resume: Past continuous = background, past simple = events, past perfect = before. All of a sudden, it turned out that, to my surprise, in the end.
devoir: Write and record a 1-minute story with suspense.
